data.define: To answer criticism quickly and cleverly.

misuse.text: Don't 'clap back' at a parent's advice.

publish.title: What does "clap back" mean?
publish.value: Clap back = Reply with a sharp comeback. Example: "She clapped back with a great reply." (casual English, US).
